lean.statement: ∀ (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (n : ℕ) [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ E = n + 1)] (x : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1) (f : E → ℝ) (g : E), HasGradientAt f g (x : E) → ∀ z : (ℝ ∙ (x : E))ᗮ, ((∀ w : TangentSpace (𝓡 n) x, mvfderiv (𝓡 n) (fun y : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 => f (y : E)) x w = inner ℝ (mvfderiv (𝓡 n) ((↑) : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1 → E) x w) (z : E)) ↔ z = (ℝ ∙ (x : E))ᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto g)
approved_definition_context: Metric.sphere (0:E) 1 is the set of vectors with norm1. (ℝ ∙ x)ᗮ is the orthogonal complement of the real linear span of x, with its inherited inner product.
Fact (Module.finrank ℝ E=n+1) supplies the finite-dimensional sphere model dimension. 𝓡 n is the real n-dimensional manifold model.

TangentSpace I x is the abstract tangent type of the manifold modeled on I. mvfderiv I h x is the actual differential of h into a vector space, as a continuous linear map on that tangent type; it is totalized to zero without differentiability.
HasGradientAt f g x certifies a genuine ambient Fréchet derivative represented by the linear functional v↦inner ℝ g v.

The inclusion ((↑):sphere (0:E)1→E) is the literal subtype inclusion. orthogonalProjectionOnto maps an ambient vector into the indicated orthogonal subspace. Subtype coercions send candidate vectors into E.
